passive.name: Short Fuse
passive.description: Periodically, Ziggs' next basic attack deals bonus magic damage. This cooldown is reduced whenever Ziggs uses an ability.

spells.name: Bouncing Bomb
spells.description: Ziggs throws a bouncing bomb that deals magic damage.

spells.name: Satchel Charge
spells.description: Ziggs flings an explosive charge that detonates after seconds, or when this ability is Recast. It deals magic damage to enemies and Knocks them Back. Ziggs is also knocked away, but takes no damage. Satchel Charge will automatically destroy towers below % of their Health.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Hexplosive Minefield
spells.description: Ziggs scatters proximity mines that detonate on enemy contact, dealing magic damage and Slows by % for seconds. Mines last seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Mega Inferno Bomb
spells.description: Ziggs hurls his ultimate creation, dealing magic damage in the center of the blast radius, or magic damage at the edge.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation EmpoweredDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
